scope: P34-02 initial pass: 32 unique questions over the ingested BNS/BNSS/BSA 2023 snapshot only. Not current law or case law. The 500-question scale pass belongs to P34-02b.
counting: categories and acts count rows. acts.null counts multi-act rows once, without duplicating them under individual acts.
review_policy: gold_retrieval records observed retrieval plus corpus inspection; corpus_section records title lookups. needs_legal_review=false means no fact-specific legal application was labeled. All generated_candidate rows require legal review. Their gold_citation_ids are non-exhaustive research candidates, not accepted legal answers.
metrics_note: P34-03 citation-overlap metrics are proxies for matching research targets, not measures of legal correctness.

generator.algorithm: Select kind=section entries, excluding the three retrieval seeds; sort lexically by citation_id. Within each act, select indices (seed + i * stride) % pool_size for i=0..per_act-1. Pool sizes are BNS=357, BNSS=530, BSA=169; stride is coprime to each. IDs are p34-02-direct-{citation_id}; queries use whitespace-normalized corpus section titles.
generator.output: 18 corpus_section rows in act_order. Three hand retrieval seeds and eleven manual generated_candidate rows are retained verbatim in questions_v2.json; this function never generates or upgrades their provenance.

retrieval_evidence.method: Offline backend.app.retrieval.sparse.SparseRetriever.search(query, top_k=5, act=act); SparseRetriever.check passed the existing index and chunk checks. No Ollama or live Qdrant call.

seeds.additional_evidence: User-confirmed P34-01 live smoke; local smoke.json rank 1 chunk-78cd90bb784ba9e8be4e669c points to the same section. smoke.json is not a test dependency.
